29703.d: The Northern Wilderness Volcano (marked as Volcano on the map) is a tall volcano located in the north-easternmost section of the Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to the entrance of the Dragonkin Laboratory via a boss portal and walk through the gate guarded by Sif. Go through the gate in the fence to the north.
• Use the obelisk network to teleport to the obelisk located in level 50 Wilderness next to the Rogues' Castle and go north. Players can only specifically select an obelisk as a teleport destination after obtaining Wilderness sword 3, otherwise it is random.
• Use obelisk shard or portable obelisk to access the network
• For free players, they have to use the lever in Edgeville to teleport to the Deserted Keep, then go a long distance east.

29842.d: The Wise Old Man in Draynor Village will assign various tasks on member worlds, and give small rewards in return.

29843.d: The Wise Old Signpost is a scenery object that appeared on top of the Wise Old Man south of Grand Exchange in Varrock after the end of the Golden Cape Hunt event at the start of 10 July 2023.

29844.d: The wise skinweaver is a Tier 8 healing familiar that can only be created in the Daemonheim dungeons at level 79 Summoning.
29844.ex: Trained from birth to bind wounds and heal. (Tier 8)

29845.d: A wise stormbringer is a tier 8 combat Summoning familiar that can only be summoned within Daemonheim at level 73 Summoning.
29845.ex: Trained from birth to light the skies with magic. (Tier 8)

29846.d: The wise worldbearer is a familiar used while Dungeoneering.
29846.ex: Trained from birth to relieve you of your burdens. (Tier 8)

29847.d: Wish lists are scenery found in the Odd Old Man's hut in the Silvarea quarry.

29848.d: The wishing well is a piece of scenery located in the Nature Grotto.
